provider_approval_type: specific training programs approved by the Office of the Attorney General (OAG)
applicable_to: commercial lodging establishments with 10 or more rooms
all lodging establishments in the State of Texas regardless of size
required_topics: identifying and responding to human trafficking
signs that an individual may be a victim
role of employees in addressing human trafficking
reporting_contacts_required: telephone number designated by the attorney general for reporting suspected human trafficking
recordkeeping_requirements: certificate of completion which must include the date taken and the course title
risks_or_constraints: employees who report suspected acts of human trafficking cannot be disciplined or retaliated against
